about.cta.en: The original paintings hang at Hacha in Tamsui.

about.practice.zh:
阿晉的創作汲取了大師米羅（Miró）、畢卡索（Picasso）與康丁斯基（Kandinsky）的養分，並結合他眼中「融合」的當代台灣味。作品深刻融合了多重風格，以敏銳而狂熱的筆觸，剖析現代人在混亂文明下的精神圖景：

心理立體主義（Psychological Cubism）
打破傳統肖像畫結構，將多視角錯位、解構的五官重新拼貼，赤裸呈現現代人內心深處的焦慮、防衛機制與歇斯底里。

人造現實主義與符號學（Artificial Realism & Semiotics）
將古典繪畫的質地感與當代符號巧妙交織。畫面上穿插的梯子、十字架、機械電路、幾何圓圈標記，乃至街頭塗鴉風格的皇冠，象徵著科技、工業與人造符號對人性內在的重塑與滲透。

多元色彩的心靈對話（Color Dynamics）
狂躁黃綠與血色：以原始而強烈的對比張力，展現情緒爆發、精神衝突與強烈的防衛本能。
冷冽藍灰：以沉穩壓抑的色調，探討現代人際關係中的疏離、孤獨與深層凝視。
塗鴉粉紅與動態線條：結合街頭塗鴉的隨性與抽象表現，撞擊出極具爆發力的當代童趣與混亂美學。
about.practice.en:
Achin's work draws on the masters Miró, Picasso and Kandinsky, combined with what he sees as the fusion of contemporary Taiwan. His paintings blend several styles, and with sharp, feverish brushwork they examine the inner landscape of people living in a chaotic civilisation:

Psychological Cubism
He breaks the structure of the traditional portrait, reassembling facial features seen from several shifted, broken-apart viewpoints, and lays bare the anxiety, defence mechanisms and hysteria deep inside people today.

Artificial Realism & Semiotics
The texture of classical painting is woven together with contemporary signs. The ladders, crosses, machine circuits, geometric circle marks and even street-graffiti crowns that run through his pictures stand for the way technology, industry and man-made symbols seep into human nature and reshape it.

Color Dynamics
Frantic yellow-green and blood red: raw, strong contrasts that show emotional outbursts, inner conflict and a fierce instinct for self-defence.
Cold blue-grey: calm, held-back tones that explore distance, loneliness and the deep gaze in modern relationships.
Graffiti pink and moving lines: the looseness of street graffiti meets abstract expression, colliding into an explosive mix of contemporary childlike play and the beauty of chaos.

about.quote.zh: 「將自己放進畫布，讓參與的角色自己對話，直到它們安靜下來、找到平衡。」
about.quote.en: “I put myself into the canvas and let the figures in it talk to each other, until they fall quiet and find their balance.”

about.statement.zh:
阿晉（Achin）出身台灣高雄，對藝術抱持熱情——學生時代就曾將教室牆面畫滿畢卡索的《格爾尼卡》。1996 年第一家店開張時，他便拿起油漆刷把店裡的牆壁一面面畫滿，開啟了無師自通的創作之路。

如今他以油畫為主要媒材，將生活經驗、日常中的擬人物件、人體的幾何結構，如書法筆劃與積木般重新拼貼，構建出獨具一格的當代藝術視覺語言。
about.statement.en:
Achin (阿晉) comes from Kaohsiung, Taiwan, and has always had a passion for art: as a student he once covered a classroom wall with Picasso's Guernica. When his first shop opened in 1996, he picked up a house-painting brush and filled its walls one by one, setting out on his path as a self-taught artist.

Today he works mainly in oil. He takes his own life, everyday objects brought to life, and the geometry of the human body, and pieces them together again like calligraphy strokes and building blocks, building a visual language of contemporary art that is entirely his own.

about.title.en: From painted walls to a reshaped inner world

contact.headline.en: Come to Tamsui and experience the originals.

contact.intro.zh: 阿晉（Achin）的原作展示於他在淡水經營的餐廳黑客茶舖。營業時間內歡迎來看畫。拜訪阿晉本人，聊聊他創作背後的意義，收藏、委託或合作，歡迎洽詢（價格另議）。
contact.intro.en: Achin's original paintings hang at Hacha, the restaurant he runs in Tamsui, and you are welcome to see them during opening hours. Visit Achin in person and talk with him about the meaning behind his work. For collecting, commissions or collaborations, please get in touch. Prices on request.

home.headline.en: I put myself into the canvas.

home.hero_deck.zh: 無師自通的台灣畫家。以油畫將人體、符號與色彩，如積木般重新拼貼。
home.hero_deck.en: A self-taught Taiwanese painter who, in oil, pieces bodies, signs and colours back together like building blocks.

home.quote.zh: 「繪畫不是描摹現實，而是描繪人造事物的真實展現。」
home.quote.en: “Painting is not copying reality. It is showing man-made things as they truly are.”
